query: read of the permitted construction workload questions and their evidence fields
result: 11 questions whose evidence fields define: POPLATEK TYDNE = weekly issuance; POPLATEK MESICNE = monthly issuance; POPLATEK PO OBRATU = issuance after transaction; operation = VYBER refers to withdrawal in cash; status = C stands for running contract, ok so far; A2 = district names; A3 = regions; A11 = average salary; female = gender F; male = gender M; loan validity more than 12 months means duration > 12; percentage of accounts by condition = (total(amount) meeting condition / total amount) * 100; percentage of male clients = count(male clients with weekly statements) / count(clients with weekly statements) * 100.
validation_method: direct reading of the permitted construction split only; no answers, validation or held-out material read

query: .schema / table_info over the whole file
result: 8 tables: account(account_id, district_id, frequency, date), card(card_id, disp_id, type, issued), client(client_id, gender, birth_date, district_id), disp(disp_id, client_id, account_id, type), district(district_id, A2..A16), loan(loan_id, account_id, date, amount, duration, payments, status), order(order_id, account_id, bank_to, account_to, amount, k_symbol), trans(trans_id, account_id, date, type, operation, amount, balance, k_symbol, bank, account). Declared foreign keys: account.district_id to district, client.district_id to district, disp.account_id to account, disp.client_id to client, card.disp_id to disp, loan.account_id to account, order.account_id to account, trans.account_id to account.
